entities.name: Kradak
entities.description: Legendary first Warlord of Keld and first Doyen who led refugees from Parma and bonded with the Mountain.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Land founded through Kradak's pact with Jezal.

entities.name: Jezal
entities.description: Leader of the Keldon stragglers who made a pact with Kradak.

entities.name: Astor
entities.description: Warlord to whom Kradak appeared in a vision.

entities.name: The Mountain
entities.description: Lone volcano where Kradak forged a bond with the land.

entities.name: Book of Keld
entities.description: Book based on stories Kradak dictated.

entities.name: Keldon Twilight
entities.description: Coming event Kradak warned Astor about.

events.summary: Kradak reaches the summit of the Mountain and forges a bond with the land, learning to call the Flame.
events.quote: he forged a bond with the land and was granted the secret of calling a magical force

events.summary: Kradak and Jezal make a pact, founding Keld; Kradak becomes the first Doyen.
events.quote: Thus was the founding of Keld

events.summary: Kradak appears in a vision to Astor warning of the Keldon Twilight.
events.quote: Kradak appeared in a vision to the warlord Astor

relations.quote: Kradak was the legendary first Warlord of Keld
